summary: Validated 4 System Health frontend flows on /app/system-health: Compliance PDF download, Restore Preview, Passphrase Rotation (enable→rotate→disable), and page load/pill/version badge. All flows work end-to-end.

issues: Onboarding tour modal ('Welcome to Obserra SAP UAC') overlays the System Health page on first admin visit and can block interactions until dismissed. force=True bypasses it, but real users may hit dead clicks. Consider auto-skipping the tour for admins already onboarded, or dimming/lowering z-index so the underlying page remains inspectable.

critical_code_review_comments: SystemHealth.jsx is fine; testids are complete and consistent (sh-compliance-pdf, sh-encryption-*, sh-restore-*).
Onboarding tour has no data-testid for its Skip/Next controls; adding one would ease UI test automation.
seed_data_creation: Enabled snapshot encryption with TestPass123!, rotated to NewPass456!, then disabled (cleanup verified: encryption status returned to 'Off').
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 features PASS on frontend. Evidence per feature: (1) Compliance PDF: download triggered, filename 'Obserra-Compliance-Evidence-2026-08-09.pdf', success toast 'Compliance evidence PDF downloaded'. (2) Enable encryption: modal accepts passphrase, status flips to 'On — AES at rest', toast 'Snapshot encryption enabled'. (3) Restore Preview: on unencrypted backup, sh-restore-preview table renders per-collection Current→Backup with Δ values (e.g. audit_logs 2578→2573 -5) and footer '42 collection(s) · backup has 3779 docs vs 3787 current'. On an encrypted backup created earlier (unknown passphrase), backend correctly returns 403 (this is expected security behavior, not a bug). (4) Rotate passphrase: modal titled 'Rotate backup passphrase' accepts current+new, toast shows 'Passphrase rotated — 1 existing snapshot(s) re-encrypted with the new passphrase.' (5) Cleanup disable with NewPass456! succeeded, encryption status is 'Off'. Header 'System healthy' pill and version badge 'v1.0.0' visible. Only console errors were harmless 401/403 during unauth polling and one 403 from attempting preview on a pre-existing encrypted backup with wrong passphrase — expected.
